name: DisequalityDispersion.Term.support_closed
typeText:
∀ {V F : Type} {arity : F → Nat} (t : DisequalityDispersion.Term V F arity),
  DisequalityDispersion.SubtermClosed (DisequalityDispersion.Term.support t)

source.code:
theorem Term.support_closed (t : Term V F arity) : SubtermClosed t.support := by
  classical
  induction t with
  | var v =>
      intro f us h
      simp [Term.support] at h
  | app g ts ih =>
      intro f us h i
      simp only [Term.support, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_biUnion,
        Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at h ⊢
      rcases h with he | ⟨j, hj⟩
      · cases he
        exact Or.inr ⟨i, Term.mem_support_self (ts i)⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨j, ih j f us hj i⟩

lines.text: ⟨j, ih j f us hj i⟩
